name: FlexGen Power Systems, Inc.
employees: ~300–500 (2026, conflicting third-party estimates; no company figure published)
summary: FlexGen is a software-first battery energy storage integrator providing the HybridOS energy management system, engineering/integration, and lifecycle services for grid-scale storage. Founded in 2009 as a military hybrid-power hardware company (founder Josh Prueher), it pivoted to utility-scale storage integration and, after 2023, to a software-and-services model. In August 2025 it acquired the assets of bankrupt rival Powin ($36M stalking-horse bid: hardware/software IP, IT systems, spare parts), in April 2026 it acquired commissioning firm Clean Energy Services, and in June 2026 it launched European operations. Backed by Apollo Global Management ($150M, 2021), Vitol (anchored the $100M Series C, 2022), and Altira Group.
ecosystemRole: US-centric BESS integrator positioned around hardware-agnostic software and services rather than factory-built AC blocks: 25+ GWh across 200+ energy storage systems in 10+ countries under software and services after the Powin acquisition (company-reported). Historically claimed the #2 US storage-technology-provider spot and ~80% Texas share (2022, company claim, dated). Services the ex-Powin fleet and offers migration to HybridOS; European projects secured in the UK, Finland, and Sweden (2026).

productsAndServices.name: HybridOS energy management system
productsAndServices.description: Hardware-agnostic site-controls platform for single sites and multi-site fleets, with modules for EMS, battery-health analytics (HybridOS Analyze), and BMS control. HybridOS v13 (Feb 2026) added a unified real-time/historical UI, a historian data API, a fleet-view mobile app, predictive diagnostics, and native CAN BMS support.
highlights: Four control packages: ESS Block, Storage, Merchant, Renewables

productsAndServices.name: Solar power plant controller
productsAndServices.description: HybridOS extension controlling solar arrays, trackers, MET stations, capacitor banks, and solar shedding for hybrid solar-plus-storage plants; announced with the v13 release.

productsAndServices.name: Integration services
productsAndServices.description: Engineering, procurement, and commissioning for grid-scale BESS. Flagship reference: ~2.15 GWh integrated for Ameresco at three Southern California Edison substations on an emergency timeline (2021–22); 2 GWh for Vitol's VC Renewables; a 10 GWh multi-year battery supply agreement signed with CATL (2022).
highlights: Data-center angle: 'BESSUPS' utility-scale battery backup solution for data centers with Rosendin (June 2025)

productsAndServices.name: Lifecycle services & remote operations
productsAndServices.description: 24/7 Remote Operations Center in Durham providing monitoring, root-cause analysis, field-service dispatch, and augmentation planning; the company claims 99% site-level availability when software is combined with lifecycle services (unverified marketing claim).

productsAndServices.name: Powin fleet servicing & CES commissioning
productsAndServices.description: Continuing support for the ex-Powin fleet (IP, IT systems, spare parts, and former Powin staff acquired Aug 2025) with migration paths to HybridOS. Subsidiary Clean Energy Services (acquired Apr 2026) has commissioned 15+ GWh of BESS and services 4.5+ GWh of battery sites as an authorized service provider.
